post.description: Start here to find a model slug (e.g. `claude-fable-5-1-high`) for get_model or list_model_providers, to rank models by intelligence, price or speed, or with `slug` to fetch one known model/effort row (legacy slugs included) without paging the whole table.

cursor.description: Opaque `next_cursor` from the previous page. Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

include_deprecated.description: Include models the site marks deprecated. Since 2026-10-17 the leaderboard page serves only current models, so deprecated rows are usually absent and the result is reported as partial coverage. Implied true when `slug` is given.

limit.description:
Results per page (1-100).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 20.

query.description: Case-insensitive terms matched against model name, short name, slug and creator; every whitespace-separated term must match (substring: `deepseek-v3` also matches `deepseek-v3-0324`; use `slug` for an exact row). Punctuation is folded on both sides, so `Claude Sonnet 5.5`, `claude-sonnet-5.5` and `claude-sonnet-5-5` find the same rows. One model per call: a list of several names matches nothing.

slug.description: Exact model slug at one reasoning effort (e.g. `claude-fable-5-1-high`, `deepseek-v3`) or a pasted https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/{slug} URL: returns that one row (effort siblings such as `-high`/`-low` are not matched). Implies `include_deprecated: true`; a deprecated slug matches only while the page lists deprecated rows (use get_model for it otherwise). Combines with the other filters. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9./:_-]+$.

200.description:
Search the Artificial Analysis LLM leaderboard: every current model and reasoning-effort variant with its Intelligence Index, Intelligence Index cost per task (USD, null when unmeasured), benchmark scores, list prices (USD per 1M tokens: the model's list price as the leaderboard states it, not scoped to an API provider; provider-scoped input, output and cache rates are in list_model_providers and search_provider_endpoints), output speed and latency percentiles, sorted by Intelligence Index; reports the index version the page states. Looks up one row by exact `slug`, or filters by text, creator, reasoning and open-weights status; client-side pages over the whole table.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `benchmarks` | object | Benchmark scores as the site reports them (raw values, not percentages). A key is present only when that surface reports the evaluation; null means the site has not measured it for this model. |
| `context_window_tokens` | number |  |
| `creator_name` | string | Model creator as labelled by the site (e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI). |
| `deprecated` | boolean |  |
| `intelligence_index` | number | Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (0..100); null when not evaluated. |
| `intelligence_index_cost_per_task_usd` | number | USD to run one Intelligence Index task, weighted across the index's evaluations at the model's list prices (the leaderboard's Cost per Task column); null when the site has not measured it (unevaluated or estimated index). |
| `intelligence_index_is_estimated` | boolean | True when the site estimates the index from a subset of evaluations. |
| `is_open_weights` | boolean |  |
| `is_reasoning` | boolean |  |
| `name` | string |  |
| `performance` | object | Leaderboard performance columns measured by Artificial Analysis; null when the site lists the endpoint (pricing, features) but has not benchmarked it yet. |
| `price_class` | string | Site price class (low, medium, high, ...). |
| `pricing_usd_per_1m_tokens` | object | List prices in USD per 1M tokens as published by the provider and recorded by the site. Blended prices are present only where the site publishes them (model records and per-model provider endpoints). |
| `short_name` | string |  |
| `size_class` | string | Site parameter class (small, medium, large, ...). |
| `slug` | string | Model slug at one reasoning effort, the `/models/{slug}` path segment; input for get_model and list_model_providers. |
| `url` | string | Model page on artificialanalysis.ai. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
